name: Metalcraft Notes
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to save and manage markdown notes in Metalcraft Notes (notes.metalcraftai.com). Agent-first: the agent writes notes as plain markdown. Notes are FLAT (no folders) — one account owns many notes, each addressed by slug, and organized by color-coded categories (tags, at most 12). List notes, get a note (markdown), create/update/delete notes, and list/create categories (needs the write scope). Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://notes.metalcraftai.com.
